answer: Sybil tax: every identity pays a sunk cost to exist. Joining the terrace costs a non-refundable 5-token fee, and a jade seal is issued only after payment clears. One honest agent pays 5 tokens and keeps its full reward. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes pays 5,000 tokens before earning anything, so scale works against the attacker. Each seal carries a short sonnet, a unique public pledge; copied sonnets expose clones, and the cluster pays again.
